coinjoin_transactions AS (
    SELECT 
        t."hash",
        t."output_count",
        t."input_value",
        t."output_value",
        MAX(ovc.count_equal_values) as max_equal_outputs
    FROM CRYPTO.CRYPTO_BITCOIN.TRANSACTIONS t

                    AND output_value <= input_value 
                    AND max_equal_outputs > 1 THEN output_value ELSE 0 END) 
          * 100.0 / SUM(output_value), 1) as coinjoin_volume_percentage,
